explicit_evidence_changes.old_value: A candidate whom Pindrop calls “Ivan X” applied for a remote engineering role and advanced from résumé screening to a video interview on 18 February 2025. Pindrop said the candidate’s video showed unnatural facial movements and audio lag, and its detection tool flagged a face swap. Pindrop described a second interview eight days later under the same identity with a different apparent face. The company identified the application as fraudulent; the available account does not say Ivan X was hired or passed its interview identity check.
explicit_evidence_changes.new_value: A candidate whom Pindrop calls “Ivan X” applied for a remote engineering role and advanced from résumé screening to a video interview on 18 February 2025. Pindrop said the candidate’s video showed unnatural facial movements and audio lag, and its detection tool flagged a face swap. Pindrop described a second interview eight days later under the same identity with a different apparent face. The company identified the application as fraudulent; the available account does not say Ivan X was hired or passed its interview identity check. Pindrop said it knowingly allowed the second interview to proceed for observation. Its later account also described a take-home assessment and an IP-based attribution check after the first interview.
